sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a VAMP2-related disorders study
Dear VAMP2.org / Raging Raymond Foundation leadership, thank you for supporting families with VAMP2-related disorders.
We are [researcher/team, institution], writing to explore a study partnership.

Evidence links VAMP2 variants to loss of function affecting membrane fusion; gain of function and protein destabilization/misfolding remain contested, with some variants increasing spontaneous neurotransmitter release.
Existing resources include Simons Searchlight’s registry, natural history study and biorepository, and the MRC-funded UCL–Yale VAMP2 / SNAREopathy research project.

Recruiting observational studies include the retrospective multicenter survey of epilepsy-dyskinesia syndromes, Registry and Natural History of Epilepsy-Dyskinesia Syndromes, and Simons Searchlight’s online genetic changes and autism study.
Searchlight lists VAMP2 on its website, but its ClinicalTrials.gov condition list does not.
Aminopyridines have been investigated clinically, but treatment evidence is contested and limited by differing variant effects.
We would propose jointly shaping [study question and approach], with consent and ethics approval before participation.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you discuss the idea and how your community or existing registry and natural history efforts could participate with proper consent and ethics approval?
If welcome, we could arrange an introductory conversation at your convenience.
Warm regards, [name, role, institution, contact details]
